newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Churchmen join protest against WMC.
newsitem.headline: Churchmen join protest against WMC.

text.p: Churchmen have joined tribal groups in protesting against the mining exploration of Western Mining Corp in the Philippine's South Cotabato province, a parish priest said on Monday.

"It's our moral obligation to guide our flock and warn them of the inevitable destruction which will be wrought by Western's open pit mining" Roman Catholic priest Father Antonio Ampuyas of South Cotabato told reporters.
Ampuyas said priests from both north and south Cotabato provinces joined a three-day picket last week in Western's Tampakan mine.
The protestors formed human barricades and blocked Western's mountain camp in Tampakan near General Santos City, he added.
Western officials could not immediately be contacted for comment.
Western was among two foreign firms that were given mining exploration permits after the Philippine government liberalised foreign ownership in mining projects in 1995.
Its 100,000 hectare mining concession is in the provinces of Davao del Sur, Sultan Kudarat, North Cotabato and South Cotabato.

Tribal groups asked the Supreme Court early this year to void the new law allowing foreign mining firms up to 100 percent equity in local mining projects, saying natural resources were the nation's heritage.
